national.title: 17 Orang Tewas dalam Dua Penembakan Massal di Afrika Selatan
national.summary: Dua insiden penembakan massal di Afrika Selatan menewaskan 17 orang. Polisi menyebut kedua peristiwa terjadi di lokasi berbeda dan tidak saling berkaitan.

international.title: Surge of US datacenters adds equivalent of Denmark’s annual emissions, study finds
international.summary: ‘Hyperscaler’ datacenters across country draw upon dirtier power sources to meet vast energy needs, research shows The frantic buildout of “hyperscaler” datacenters in the US has collectively caused planet-heating emissions of about the same scale as Denmark emits in a year, new research has found. In that period 403 “hyperscalers” – the largest datacenters used primarily to handle the growth of artificial intelligence – emitted about 25.7m metric tons of carbon dioxide, according to the study.
